score_scale: Each method raw sigmoid score; not a common calibrated probability or KD scale.
model_selection: All six configurations retained. NetTCR primary four exclude known exact CDR3-pair overlap; all20 shown as sensitivity.
inference_unit: One sequence pair scored per model; CV models are not biological repeats.
threshold: No cutoff used in this figure; 0.5 reference classification is saved only in CSV.
statistical_tests: None; descriptive single-family case panel, not population performance benchmark.
